Select activity_id, assay_chembl_id, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, standard_type, molecule_chembl_id. Join activities with assays on assay_id to get assay_chembl_id and filter by tid = 165. Join activities with molecule_dictionary on molregno to get molecule_chembl_id. Filter where standard_type is IC50. Sort by activity_id, assay_chembl_id, molecule_chembl_id.
